method: Automated inventory read every source, evidence, pathway, profile and review record in the exact manifest candidate for this ISO.

Automated screening compared source references, locators, geography fields, evidence class, direction, status, horizon and scenario; it checked pathway support IDs, link-evidence sets, geography fields, alternatives and uncertainty for follow-up.

Raw extraction access rows are recorded only as inherited access observations. This generated screen does not treat snippets, HTTP success, prior access, or metadata as claim verification and does not replace semantic source review.

verification_summary.limitation: Selected source access and manually adjudicated record-level passages are listed separately. Verification applies only to individually listed claims; all remaining evidence/pathways and the country bank as a whole remain unresolved-limited.

pathways.compact_statement: The 2024 assessment links livelihood stress and unequal resource access with protection risks, with a historical Machinga reporting example; causal attribution is unresolved.
alternative_explanations: Food-price inflation, accumulated shocks, reporting/access changes and pre-existing gender inequality also matter.
pathways.uncertainty: A source-stated risk mechanism synthesized in July 2024, not a climate-attributable violence estimate or a 2026 protection assessment.
recommendations: Retain only evidence whose documented geography supports the pathway location; otherwise narrow the pathway or keep the evidence standalone.
